families.label: Shell And Sidebar
families.notes: Every project must use the shared shell rhythm before page-level redesign begins.

families.label: Workspace Density And Spacing
families.notes: Cards must look placed by a system, not dropped behind existing content.

families.label: Tables And Pagination
families.notes: Every data table needs a surface, density, and pagination contract.

families.label: Charts And Time Series
families.notes: Chart work must use real chart components or approved domain libraries.

families.label: Auth And Session Controls
requiredProof: proof route bypass or test password
families.notes: Auth can exist, but it cannot block certification from reaching the real dashboard surface.

families.label: Sidecars And Drawers
families.notes: Inspectors belong in reusable sidecar/drawer patterns instead of one-off local panels.

families.label: Empty Loading Error States
families.notes: Missing data must explain whether it is loading, unavailable, stale, or misconfigured.

families.label: Proof And Runtime Status
families.notes: Proof surfaces must tell the truth about running, stopped, stale, and unknown states.
